FIELDS.NAME: Precision Auto Repair & Body Shop
FIELDS.CONTACT FOR INSPECTION: John Doe, Shop Manager, Precision Auto Repair & Body Shop, (555) 123-4567
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Precision Auto Repair & Body Shop specializes in providing high-quality auto repair and maintenance services for private passenger vehicles. Our operations include routine services such as oil changes, tire rotations, brake inspections, and light mechanical repairs, ensuring that our customers' vehicles are well-maintained and safe to drive. Additionally, our body shop is equipped to handle cosmetic repairs and paintwork, performed by certified technicians in a controlled environment. We prioritize routine preventive maintenance to prolong vehicle life and enhance safety. Operating in a suburban location with low crime rates, we have effective inventory management practices and strong vendor relationships for parts supply to minimize operational delays. Our facilities comply with environmental regulations, and we ensure that our staff members have the required certifications and licenses as mandated by state law. Overall, our goal is to provide dependable, efficient services while maintaining the highest standards of quality and safety for our customers.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not engage in emergency or contract wrecker/towing services and confirms that light auto repair is limited solely to private passenger and pick-up vehicles. Additionally, brake work is conducted only as an incidental service to other repairs, and we maintain a minimum $500 property damage deductible per claim for any car wash exposure.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a customer vehicle experienced damage due to an accidental drop of a tool from a lift during routine maintenance, resulting in an estimated loss of $10,000. The claim was processed successfully and is now resolved. On 01/20/2023, water damage occurred in the shop due to a burst pipe, leading to repairs costing $15,000. This claim is also resolved. Total losses amount to $25,000.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM, Closed on Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Safe Class: UL 608, Grade: Group 1, Label: Fire Resistant
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Secure, fenced parking lot with lighting and a watchperson on duty during operating hours.
